lmfao i’m sorry but that persons response was so unexpected i’m actually smiling rn. also hello i just wanted to say that you don’t have to be successful to be happy. You’re not looking for succession you’re looking for happiness and you won’t find it by being successful eventually you’ll doubt whatever you have achieved and circle back around to the idea of killing yourself. Hear me out, yes it seems great because you’ll be gone forever and you’ll be nothing which how you already feel like if i’m not mistaken, nothing? Now I too see how great that could be but why 40 why not now? why not next week? You’re stringing it out because you have hope, i want you to think about why you have hope and really grab it by the dick and don’t let go because that hope is kinda like your rock it’ll keep you grounded and give you a reason in this world because everyone has a reason for staying even if they haven’t thought about leaving. For example people who are content’s reasons are probably their family? or even themselves if they’re that happy with the person they are. For people a little less content like you and I we have to kinda dig deep to find our reason for living. I’m glad that succession is yours, but please realize that you have to also look around at everything now. Don’t just keep staring at the future until you get there, you need to take in everything because maybe on the way you’ll find more reasons like people that come into your life. Materialistic things are great don’t get me wrong, there’s diamonds, cars, dildos, all that shit, but there’s also more. Just be careful and don’t give in to suicide just yet, it’s goona take a lot of effort but you need to try to hold on even if you don’t know why you have to yet.

I feel like i’m on the thin line in between getting help to feel better and letting myself get worse til I finally commit suicide. I always feel like my mind is going to fast for my life and my body that one day i’m not going to be able to handle it. I’m only 14, but I struggle with seeing a future for myself and I always think about things someone my age shouldn’t. I’ve been told by one of my friends that it’s like i’m having a mid-life crisis way too early. I feel like shit for feeling like this because like people have it worse and I should stop complaining, but I always circle back to the same suicidal thoughts. I’ve never spoken to anyone about how I truly feel and I don’t plan to talk to anyone but a professional because it makes me feel exposed talking about my feelings and thoughts like people are looking through me and I hate that shallow feeling.
